events.title: Freddie Mercury tribute
events.blurb: Remembering Queen's iconic frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Rock legend's legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost a true showman. Freddie Mercury's incredible voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Timeless album
angles.copy: More than just an album, 'Rubber Soul' changed the game. What's your favourite track from this Beatles classic?

events.title: John Lennon tribute
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who tragically passed away on this day in 1980, he would have been 87.

angles.name: Remembering a legend
angles.copy: Forty-six years since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today.

angles.name: Starman's 80th
angles.copy: Eighty years since the birth of the Starman. David Bowie's influence on music, fashion and culture is simply immeasurable.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have turned 92 today.

angles.name: The King's 92nd
angles.copy: Ninety-two years since Elvis Presley was born. The King's legacy continues to shake, rattle, and roll generations.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to Led Zeppelin guitar legend Jimmy Page.

angles.name: Guitar God's 83rd
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young for the legendary Jimmy Page. Still inspiring guitarists everywhere.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Sir Rod Stewart.

angles.name: Rod the Mod's 82nd
angles.copy: Eighty-two today for the one and only Rod Stewart! Still got that unmistakable voice.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Happy 66th birthday to Madness frontman Suggs.

angles.name: Madness frontman's 66th
angles.copy: Happy 66th to the legendary Suggs! One Step Beyond... another year older.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Happy 71st birthday to 80s pop icon Paul Young.

angles.name: 80s heartthrob's 71st
angles.copy: Seventy-one today for Paul Young! Still got us wanting to 'Come Back and Stay'.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Happy 81st birthday to the legendary country music icon Dolly Parton.

angles.name: Queen of Country's 81st
angles.copy: Eighty-one and still working 9 to 5! Happy birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Happy 56th birthday to Take That frontman Gary Barlow.

angles.name: Take That star's 56th
angles.copy: Fifty-six today for the man behind so many hits, Gary Barlow. What's your favourite Take That song?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Happy 77th birthday to the smooth-voiced singer Billy Ocean.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen's 77th
angles.copy: Seventy-seven today for the 'Caribbean Queen' himself, Billy Ocean! Still sounding fantastic.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony.

angles.name: Rock history made
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock history was made as the first artists entered the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame. Who would you induct today?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Happy 55th birthday to Take That member Mark Owen.

angles.name: Take That's Mark turns 55
angles.copy: Fifty-five today for the ever-youthful Mark Owen! Still bringing the pop magic.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in 1969.

angles.name: Rooftop history
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles took to the rooftop for their unforgettable final public performance. Imagine being there!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Happy 76th birthday to Genesis frontman and solo superstar Phil Collins.

angles.name: Music legend's 76th
angles.copy: Seventy-six today for the incredible Phil Collins! A true drumming and vocal icon.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Happy 67th birthday to beloved British actor Hugh Grant.

angles.name: Charming at 67
angles.copy: Happy 67th to the effortlessly charming Hugh Grant! From rom-coms to dramas, he's always a delight.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Happy 46th birthday to pop superstar Justin Timberlake.

angles.name: Pop Prince's 46th
angles.copy: Forty-six today for the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boyband to solo sensation.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to national treasure Sir David Jason.

angles.name: Only Fools and 87
angles.copy: Eighty-seven today for the legendary Sir David Jason! A true icon of British television. Lovely jubbly!

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens and The Big Bopper, who tragically died in a plane crash on this day in 1959.

angles.name: Remembering music legends
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years since 'The Day The Music Died'. We remember Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens and The Big Bopper.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Happy 61st birthday to 'Never Gonna Give You Up' singer Rick Astley.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up... 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one today for the man who's never gonna give you up! Happy birthday, Rick Astley.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Remembering reggae legend Bob Marley, who would have turned 82 today.

angles.name: Reggae icon's 82nd
angles.copy: Eighty-two years since the birth of the iconic Bob Marley. His message of peace and unity lives on.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Happy 85th birthday to legendary singer-songwriter Carole King.

angles.name: Songwriting royalty's 85th
angles.copy: Eighty-five today for the incredible Carole King! A true songwriting force who shaped generations of music.

events.title: Whitney Houston tribute
events.blurb: Remembering the incredible voice of Whitney Houston, who passed away on this day in 2012, she would have been 64.

angles.name: The Voice remembered
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost 'The Voice'. Whitney Houston's unparalleled talent continues to inspire.

events.title: Take That split anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, Take That announced their initial split, breaking hearts across the nation.

angles.name: The day the music stopped (briefly)
angles.copy: Remember the day Take That first split up? Twenty-nine years ago, a generation cried. Thank goodness they came back!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: Happy 68th birthday to UB40 frontman Ali Campbell.

angles.name: Red Red Wine... 68!
angles.copy: Sixty-eight today for the distinctive voice of UB40, Ali Campbell! Still making us feel 'Red Red Wine'.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Happy 36th birthday to global superstar Ed Sheeran.

angles.name: Modern icon's 36th
angles.copy: Thirty-six today for the phenomenal Ed Sheeran! Still dominating the charts and our playlists.

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles' 'Quiet Beatle' George Harrison, who would have turned 84 today.

angles.name: Quiet Beatle's 84th
angles.copy: Eighty-four years since the birth of George Harrison. His timeless songs and spiritual journey continue to inspire.
